answer: Color-split admission: each new account is a vertex in an endorsement graph and joins only with two witnesses holding different credential classes, one saffron, one pearl; no address may hold both. A farmer cannot mint unlike credentials from one pool, so each puppet needs two separate sponsors that passed liveness checks themselves. Cloning means farming witnesses: N puppets demand 2N independent, unlinked sponsors, each burning its own deposit, no bulk discount. Witnesses with overlapping histories are flagged and forfeit, so honest users pay once.
